create_core_profiles_to_IMAS: create an IMAS core_profiles IDS from TORAX simulation outputs including profiles, sources, and geometry
build_global_quantities_IMAS: build global quantities like Ip, beta, li_3, and volume-averaged temperature and density into an IMAS IDS
fill_profiles_1d_IMAS: fill 1D radial profiles including electron and ion temperature, density, pressure, q-factor, and magnetic shear into an IMAS IDS
fill_profiles_1d_ions_IMAS: fill per-ion profiles for main ions and impurities including temperature, density, and element properties into an IMAS IDS
fill_profiles_1d_grid_IMAS: fill radial grid coordinates including rho_tor_norm, rho_tor, psi, volume, and area into an IMAS IDS profiles_1d
